props.title: An Afro house DJ in Denver, with live tabla over the set.
props.lede: You know the point in a house set when the drums lock in and the people standing at the edge of the floor start to move. This DJ plays Afro house, deep house and amapiano, and can sit down at a pair of tabla drums and play them live over the records.

headingText.html: It books for a conference after-party, an office holiday party, a wedding reception or a birthday, anywhere the night wants a dance floor on house music.

props.headingNote: We build the act around your night, from the number of musicians to the songs and what they wear. Here’s how booking through Signet works.

props.title: Live drums over the records.
props.lede: The DJ trained in Indian classical music on the tabla, a pair of hand drums. Played live, they give the crowd a musician to watch as well as music to dance to, and the same set works without them when you book the DJ on their own.

props.html: The DJ has played Denver's house clubs and club nights in Chicago, San Francisco, San Diego and Hong Kong, and can play the warm-up while a crowd is still arriving and talking, the peak of the night once the floor is full, or one long set that covers both.

items.q: What does the Afro house DJ play?
items.a: Afro house, deep house and amapiano, with global electronic records worked into the set. It's a Denver DJ booked through Signet Artists, with live tabla over the set when you want it.

items.q: Can the tabla be added to any booking?
items.a: Yes. Ask for it when you send the date and it's priced with the rest of the booking.

items.q: How long does the DJ play?
items.a: Anywhere from one hour to four, with the breaks planned around your program.

items.q: Does the DJ play outside Denver?
items.a: Yes, across Colorado, and travel outside the Denver metro is priced with the date.

props._notes: Buyer questions only; no equipment or setup.
